newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones inched up by 8.51 points to 5,656.90. PLDT's ADR was up by $ 1/8 to $60 1/8.
* The peso closed at 26.228 to a U.S.dollar from 26.254. * The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,197.60, down 10.29.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate rose to 12.78125 percent from 11.5625.
